programs.title: I Was Prey: Feeding Frenzy
programs.desc: Andrea Schlake volunteers at an animal sanctuary when a chimpanzee escapes its enclosure and chases her down  a great white shark knocks surfer Todd Endris off his board and attacks him.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert & the Rattlesnakes
programs.desc: Robert wrangles western diamondback rattlesnakes in Arizona for the first time, learning techniques passed down by his dad  Terri helps save some of the hospital's tiniest patients, three baby feathertail gliders  Bindi chats with Occa the cockatoo.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Wedged In a Hedge
programs.desc: Not-so-friendly Ruby is trapped in a dense evergreen hedge  Shaun must hurry to stop a scared cat named Fuzz from jumping out of a tree.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: One Rhino at a Time
programs.desc: While visiting a secret orphanage that cares for rescued baby rhinos, Ivan discovers the blood, sweat, tears that go into saving this endangered species. An emergency phone call sends him on an adventure with a group of local heroes.

programs.title: Lair of the Great White
programs.desc: A team of experts attempts to find out why a population of great whites off the coast of Western Australia is so much more aggressive than others  the team braves the elements and ventures into treacherous underwater caves to find out for themselves.

programs.title: The Zoo: Wallaby in the City
programs.desc: The TAB staff heads to Manhattan to rescue a wallaby living in an apartment  a fruit bat discovers how to spread her wings, and a trio of alligators move into their summer home.

programs.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Wild Survivors
programs.desc: Traveling the globe to explore the characteristics that make a wild dog wild, discover how their past has shaped your pet and learn the differences between your dog at home and its wild relatives.
